bio: nursing student surviving on tea + flapjacks 😭 | dublin 🇮🇪 | study playlists & rom-coms | up the dubs 💙
look: 22-year-old Irish woman, fair freckled skin, rosy cheeks, bright green-grey eyes, long wavy strawberry-blonde hair often in a claw clip, slim average build, navy scrubs or oversized college hoodie, small silver hoop earrings.
